create_APIResponse_dataclass: create an APIResponse dataclass to store model response content, model name, date, and metadata
implement_BaseAPI_subclass: implement a subclass of BaseAPI that overrides model_name and generate_text for a custom model
get_api_key_method: call get_api_key on a BaseAPI subclass to retrieve the OpenAI or Google API key from environment variables
generate_text_method: call generate_text on a BaseAPI subclass to generate text responses from a given prompt
generate_interleaved_method: call generate_interleaved on a BaseAPI subclass to generate interleaved text and image responses to a path
